## Statute

Section 3306(a)(2)(B) (lines 265-272):

"(2) Agricultural labor

In the case of agricultural labor, the term "employer" means, with respect to any calendar year, any person who-

    (A) during the calendar year or the preceding calendar year paid wages of $20,000 or more for agricultural labor, or

    (B) on each of some 10 days during the calendar year or during the preceding calendar year, each day being in a different calendar week, employed at least 5 individuals in employment in agricultural labor for some portion of the day."

## Reasoning

Section 3306(a)(2)(B) defines an employer for agricultural labor as a person who, on each of some 10 days during the calendar year (each day in a different calendar week), employed at least 5 individuals in agricultural labor.

The case facts show Alice employed agricultural workers on the following dates in 2017:
- Jan 24: 5 employees (Bob, Cameron, Dan, Emily, Fred)
- Feb 4: 5 employees (Bob, Cameron, Dan, Emily, Fred)
- Mar 3: 5 employees (Bob, Cameron, Dan, Emily, Fred)
- Mar 18: 5 employees (Cameron, Dan, Emily, Fred, George)
- Apr 1: 5 employees (Bob, Cameron, Dan, Fred, George)
- May 9: 5 employees (Cameron, Dan, Emily, Fred, George)
- Oct 14: 5 employees (Bob, Cameron, Dan, Emily, George)
- Oct 25: 6 employees (Bob, Cameron, Dan, Emily, Fred, George)
- Nov 8: 5 employees (Bob, Cameron, Emily, Fred, George)
- Nov 22: 5 employees (Bob, Cameron, Dan, Emily, Fred)
- Dec 1: 5 employees (Bob, Cameron, Dan, Emily, George)
- Dec 2: 5 employees (Bob, Cameron, Dan, Emily, George)

Using ISO calendar week calculation (as verified with Python):
- Jan 24, 2017: Week 4
- Feb 4, 2017: Week 5
- Mar 3, 2017: Week 9
- Mar 18, 2017: Week 11
- Apr 1, 2017: Week 13
- May 9, 2017: Week 19
- Oct 14, 2017: Week 41
- Oct 25, 2017: Week 43
- Nov 8, 2017: Week 45
- Nov 22, 2017: Week 47
- Dec 1, 2017: Week 48
- Dec 2, 2017: Week 48

Number of unique calendar weeks = 11 (computed: 12 dates - 1 duplicate week 48 = 11 unique weeks)

Since 11 >= 10 (the threshold in Section 3306(a)(2)(B)), and each employment day had at least 5 employees (ranging from 5 to 6), Alice satisfies the condition in Section 3306(a)(2)(B) for 2017.

## Answer
Answer: Entailment
